form.label: Status
form.description: Collector health per input: last run, events and devices collected, how far behind, errors, and what reached the index. Collector logs come from index _internal; events from the index entered below (* = all indexes, slower).

search.query: | tstats count where index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:log" by source | rex field=source "absolute_se_(?:events|devices)_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | stats sum(count) as count by input | sort input

index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:log" source="*absolute_se_*_$input$.log*" | rex field=source "absolute_se_(?<input_kind>events|devices)_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | rex field=message "^run (?<run_result>done|failed|skipped|stopped): " | rex field=message "^run done: written (?<written>\d+), duplicates (?<duplicates>\d+), excluded (?<excluded>\d+), api calls (?<api_calls>\d+)" | rex field=message "^run done: devices (?<devices>\d+), pages \d+, api calls (?<api_calls_dev>\d+), (?<megabytes>[\d.]+) MB" | rex field=message "behind (?<behind_min>-?[\d.]+) min" | eval ran=if(in(run_result, "done", "failed"), run_result, null()), run_time=if(isnotnull(ran), _time, null()), err=if(in(log_level, "ERROR", "CRITICAL"), message, null()), err_time=if(isnotnull(err), _time, null()) | stats latest(_time) as last_log max(run_time) as last_run latest(ran) as last_result latest(written) as last_written latest(devices) as last_devices latest(megabytes) as last_mb latest(behind_min) as behind_min latest(api_calls) as api_calls sum(written) as written_total max(err_time) as err_time latest(err) as last_error by input_kind input | eval status=case(isnull(last_run), "NO RUN YET", last_result=="failed", "FAILED", input_kind=="events" AND now()-last_run>1800, "LATE", input_kind=="devices" AND now()-last_run>93600, "LATE", tonumber(behind_min)>60, "BEHIND", true(), "OK") | eval last_run=strftime(last_run, "%F %T"), last_log=strftime(last_log, "%F %T"), last_error=if(err_time>=coalesce(strptime(last_run, "%F %T"), 0) OR status=="FAILED", last_error, null()) | table input input_kind status last_run last_written written_total behind_min last_devices last_mb last_log last_error | sort input

index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:log" source="*absolute_se_events_$input$.log*" "run done: written" | rex field=source "absolute_se_events_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "run done: written (?<written>\d+), duplicates (?<duplicates>\d+)" | timechart sum(written) by input

panel.title: Minutes behind (end of the last collected window, SIEM events)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:log" source="*absolute_se_events_$input$.log*" "run done" "behind" | rex field=source "absolute_se_events_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "behind (?<behind_min>-?[\d.]+) min" | timechart max(behind_min) by input

panel.title: Run log: runs, first runs, skips, stops, failures

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:log" source="*absolute_se_*_$input$.log*" ("run done" OR "run failed" OR "run skipped" OR "run started" OR "first run" OR "run requested" OR "run stopped" OR "stopped by Splunk") | rex field=source "absolute_se_(?<input_kind>events|devices)_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | table _time input input_kind log_level message | sort - _time

index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:log" source="*absolute_se_*_$input$.log*" (WARNING OR ERROR OR CRITICAL) | rex field=source "absolute_se_(?<input_kind>events|devices)_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | search log_level IN (WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) | eval pattern=replace(message, "\d+", "N") | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen latest(message) as latest_example by input log_level pattern | sort - last_seen | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | table input log_level count last_seen latest_example

panel.title: Indexed SIEM events per account (by event time, 1-hour buckets)

search.query: | tstats count where index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" by _time host span=1h | timechart span=1h sum(count) by host

panel.title: How late SIEM events arrive (index time minus event time, last 4 hours indexed)

search.query: index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:events" _index_earliest=-4h | eval lag_min=(_indextime-_time)/60 | stats count as events perc50(lag_min) as p50_min perc95(lag_min) as p95_min max(lag_min) as max_min by host | foreach *_min [ eval <<FIELD>>=round(<<FIELD>>, 1) ]
| tstats count where index="$idx$" sourcetype="absolute:devices" by _time host span=1h | timechart span=1h sum(count) by host

panel.title: Splunk messages about the inputs (start-up and script errors)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd (component=ExecProcessor OR component=ModularInputs) ("absolute_events" OR "absolute_devices") log_level!=INFO | eval message=coalesce(event_message, _raw) | table _time host log_level component message | sort - _time

panel.title: Changes made on the Inputs page

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="absolute:ta:webapi" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>[A-Z]+) (?<message>.*)" | table _time host log_level message | sort - _time
